notes: Access: direct fetch worked throughout (no WAF/blocking encountered); robots.txt (https://www.xenos.nl/robots.txt) has no ClaudeBot/anthropic-ai specific disallow, only standard filter/sort-param and account/checkout exclusions applied evenly to all crawlers. Xenos is a Dutch discount/lifestyle variety chain (no prior precedent in this project); site is a live, actively operated Magento-family storefront (custom Vue-component storefront) with a full mega-menu covering Home Accessories, Furniture, Garden, Dining, Food & Drink, Household, Party and Hobby departments -- most of the catalogue (furniture, food/drink, cleaning, storage, party supplies, craft/hobby, travel/leisure, wallpaper-adjacent textiles) is out of scope per the decision rule and was excluded. Qty method: every category page server-renders a JSON blob (double-quote-encoded in an HTML attribute) containing total_items/current_page/last_page/page_size for that exact node, alongside a human-visible 'catalog__header-count' badge next to the H1 (e.g. 'Alle Wandspiegels (44)'). Both numbers were cross-checked and agreed on every row extracted here. Exhaustion additionally verified via ceil(total_items/page_size)==last_page on every multi-page category, and by re-fetching a page past last_page (schaaltjes-kommetjes ?page=9) and confirming total_items stayed fixed rather than growing. Canonical https://www.xenos.nl/... URLs used throughout (no translate.goog/jina/Wayback needed). Rule 0 gains: included garden/outdoor lighting (Garden Torches, Solar Lighting under /tuin/tuinverlichting/) that a room-blind pass would have dropped as 'garden' items; included Makeup Mirrors and Full-Length Mirrors alongside Wall Mirrors; included Wall Shelves and Wall Hooks under Wall Decor per the explicit decorative-wall-rack/hook allowance; included Mugs (Senseo pod mugs, Latte Macchiato mugs) per the Glassware rule's explicit 'tea & coffee cups, mugs' inclusion; included Outdoor Dinnerware (Buitenservies) as a genuine dinnerware sub-type rather than dropping it for being outdoor-themed. Excluded per Home Fragrance rule: Geurkaarsen (scented candles), Geur in huis (home fragrance: wierook/incense, geurolie/fragrance oil, waxmelts, geurstokjes/reed diffusers, huisparfum/home perfume, oliebranders/oil burners), and 'The Scent' fragrance line. Excluded Citronella kaars (functional insect-repellent candle, not decorative) and Herdenkingslichten (memorial/grave-site candles, funerary rather than home-decor use). Excluded Kunstplanten/Kunstbloemen (artificial plants/flowers) and Gieters (watering cans, functional garden tool) from Bloemen en planten, keeping only Vazen/Bloempotten/Plantenbakken. Excluded Manden (generic storage baskets), Deurknoppen (door hardware), Rolgordijnen (roller blinds/window textile), Opbergboeken (storage boxes) and Wandkasten (wall storage cabinets -- furniture, unlike Wandrekken open shelving which was kept). Excluded all of Meubels (furniture), Woontextiel (cushions/throws/rugs), Huishouden (fans, waste bins, general storage, bath/shower hardware, cleaning, laundry, batteries), Feest (party supplies/gift-wrap/costumes -- treated as Holiday & Gift), Hobby (craft supplies), Eten en drinken (all food/drink consumables), Reizen en vrije tijd (travel/luggage/camping/pet/sports -- verified via its own sub-nav, zero decor relevance), Cadeaus (gift/price-tier landing page), and the entire /ruimtes 'shop by room' branch (confirmed via page title 'Badkamer inspiratie' = 'Bathroom inspiration' -- these are curated inspiration/marketing landing pages, not distinct catalogue nodes, so excluded under the Inspiration NEVER-EXTRACT rule rather than emitted as Rule-0.6 room-overlap rows). Within Koken en Tafelen, excluded Bestek (cutlery/flatware), Koken (cookware/kitchen tools), Bakspullen (bakeware), Bewaren en Meenemen (food storage), Koffie en Thee (teapots/coffee accessories), Keuken- en Tafeltextiel (napkins/tablecloths/tea towels), Funcooking (popcorn/fondue appliances), Tafelmomenten (thematic occasion roll-ups) and Cocktailshakers (bar tool) under Serveren. Within Servies, excluded the 'Shop op kleur' colour-facet recut and the colour-facet children of Borden (Blauwe/Witte/Zwarte/Grijze/Groene borden), keeping only genuine plate-type sub-categories. Within Tuin, excluded Tuinmeubelen (garden furniture), Tuinkussens (cushions), and Tuindecoratie's Buitenkleden (outdoor rugs), Parasols, Hangmatten (hammocks), Vuurschalen (fire bowls, functional), Schaduwdoeken (shade sails) and Balkon (confirmed via title 'Balkon meubels kopen' = balcony-furniture landing page, no structured count present either). Decoratieve beelden (14 total, general decorative statues) is nested with a further child Boeddha beelden (5) in the site's own nav, so per the hierarchy convention it is emitted as a parent grouping row with only its exposed leaf child (Buddha Statues) counted, consistent with how all other multi-child branches (Kaarsen, Servies, Borden, Mokken, etc.) are handled in this file. No same-domain/sister-brand duplicate-company concern applies to Xenos -- it is a standalone Netherlands-only variety chain with no other roster row on this project.
